# Berlo Communications Ltd.
> Premier Strategic Public Relations, Media Relations, Corporate Communications & Crisis Advisory Agency in Bangladesh.

Founded: 2012
Headquarters: Apartment - B3, House - 32/34, Road - 07, Block - C, Niketon, Gulshan-1, Dhaka, Bangladesh.

Official Emails: contact@berlocommunications.com, shatarupa@berlocommunications.com
Official Website: https://berlocommunications.com

## Agency Overview
Berlo Communications Ltd. is an established corporate communications consultancy founded in 2012 in Dhaka, Bangladesh. The agency specializes in strategic narrative engineering, tier-1 media access, executive thought leadership, and 24/7 crisis war-room mobilization for public-listed conglomerates, multinational corporations, trade bodies, and development organizations.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- Strategic PR & Corporate Reputation: Long-term corporate narrative architecture, institutional positioning, and stakeholder trust frameworks.
- Strategic Media Relations & Press Distribution: Guaranteed editorial placement across 100+ national dailies, television networks, and business bureaus.
- Crisis Communication & Issues Advisory: Under-60-minute war-room deployment, spokesperson crisis simulation, rumor containment, and reputation rehabilitation.
- Corporate Communications & Governance Advisory: C-suite messaging, board-level stakeholder alignment, ESG sustainability reporting, and M&A advisory.
- Government Affairs & Public Policy Advocacy: White papers, ministerial roundtables, and constructive public-private partnership dialogue.
- Events & Experiential Brand Activations: Turnkey execution of press conferences, international trade summits, grand product launches, and nationwide roadshows.
- Executive Thought Leadership & C-Suite Profiling: Op-ed ghostwriting, keynote speaking placements, and executive personal branding.
- Visual & Digital Storytelling: Corporate documentaries, annual report design, infographics, and investor communication assets.
- Digital PR & Influencer Outreach: Online reputation management (ORM), AI-powered sentiment analysis, and credible B2B influencer partnerships.

## Verified Key Metrics
- 12+ Years of continuous agency excellence (Est. 2012).
- 250+ Enterprise PR campaigns executed.
- 100+ Tier-1 national newsrooms actively engaged.
- 98.7% Front-page and prime-time placement success rate.
- <30 min Average emergency crisis response triage.
- 120+ Active news desks and business bureaus network.
